title: A Novel ψ-χ Fusion Protein for Unravelling the Contributions of χ to DNA Replication and Repair
authors: Kaylie A. Padgett-Pagliai; Elise Wimer; Jacob D. Grant; Matthew J. Petrides; Elijah S. P. Newcomb; Vincent A. Sutera; Susan T. Lovett; Linda B. Bloom
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大肠杆菌DNA复制修复中ψ-χ融合蛋白对χ-SSB互作的影响，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅生化实验，故评分较低。
abstract: Faithful DNA replication in Escherichia coli requires the DNA polymerase III holoenzyme (DNA pol III HE) and its clamp loader complex, which couples processive DNA synthesis with β-clamp loading. The clamp loader accessory subunits χ and ψ link single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) to the replisome, stabilizing replication on SSB-coated templates through interactions with the SSB C-terminal tail. Chi has also been implicated in tolerance to the chain-terminating nucleoside analog azidothymidine (AZT), though whether this function depends on χ within DNA pol III HE or on its independent interaction with the YoaA helicase remains unclear. To address this, we engineered ψ-χ fusion proteins with flexible glycine-serine linkers to tether the two subunits while preserving folding and activity. Both fusions were biochemically competent, supporting ATP hydrolysis and clamp loading on SSB-coated DNA. In vivo, however, neither the ψ-GS12-χ fusion nor expression of a ψχ operon restored AZT tolerance in Δ holC cells, whereas expression of χ alone was sufficient. Fusion expression impaired growth in both wild-type (WT) and Δ holC backgrounds, a phenotype alleviated by disrupting χ-SSB binding. These findings support a model in which χ must dynamically engage SSB and YoaA outside of the clamp loader to promote AZT tolerance, highlighting the importance of regulated χ-SSB interactions in genome maintenance.
abstract_zh: 在大肠杆菌中，忠实的DNA复制需要DNA聚合酶III全酶（DNA pol III HE）及其钳载复合物，该复合物将持续性DNA合成与β-钳加载偶联。钳载辅助亚基χ和ψ将单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）连接到复制体，通过与SSB C末端尾部的相互作用，稳定SSB包被模板上的复制。Chi也被认为与链终止核苷类似物叠氮胸苷（AZT）的耐受性有关，尽管这一功能是否依赖于DNA pol III HE中的χ或其与YoaA解旋酶的独立相互作用仍不清楚。为解决此问题，我们设计了具有柔性甘氨酸-丝氨酸接头的ψ-χ融合蛋白，以连接这两个亚基，同时保持折叠和活性。两种融合蛋白在生化上均具有功能，支持ATP水解和SSB包被DNA上的钳加载。然而，在体内，ψ-GS12-χ融合蛋白或ψχ操纵子的表达均未恢复Δ holC细胞中的AZT耐受性，而单独表达χ则足以恢复。融合表达在野生型（WT）和Δ holC背景下均损害生长，这一表型通过破坏χ-SSB结合得以缓解。这些发现支持一个模型，即χ必须在钳载复合物之外动态结合SSB和YoaA以促进AZT耐受性，突显了调控的χ-SSB相互作用在基因组维持中的重要性。
